metric_notes.frac_ever_fired: cumulative fraction of E cells that ever fired in the representative event; used instead of max_active_frac which saturates at ~0.5 (tau_ref_E=2ms -> <=half the cells fire per 1ms bin)
metric_notes.kick_n_events: the 5 delivered pulses cluster into 3 separable whole-sheet bumps (t~190/457/695ms); counted with a bar sensitive to the near-baseline train (0.15x-peak, not the standard 0.5x); logic in src.topic4_axis_vs_core.count_events_pre_runaway (unit-tested: train=3, record-peak=1, immediate-burst=1)
metric_notes.onset_spread_ms: range of first-spike times in the representative event (big 99 / small 135 / kick 96 ms). A wide spread => a recruitment GRADIENT, not a synchronous flash -- so the figure does NOT claim 'synchronous blast / no gradient' (review P1-1)
metric_notes.core_sync10: fraction of the low-threshold core's E cells firing within 10 ms of the first core spike (big/small only): big 0.006, small 0.004 -- both tiny, i.e. the core ignites as a spreading wave, not together (spec G-A4 evidence, confirming the honest reframe)
